sections.heading: What Our Jaguar Engine Replacement Service Involves

blocks.html: We replace a worn or damaged engine with a professionally sourced replacement unit - either a rebuilt, reconditioned, or low-mileage used engine that matches your vehicle's exact specification. Every replacement is supplied and fitted by our Jaguar-specialist technicians at our Billericay workshop.

Our service includes full removal of the old engine, preparation and installation of the replacement, all necessary fluids, and thorough road testing before handover. We also take the opportunity to replace ancillary components - such as timing chains, water pumps, and plastic coolant pipes - that are far more accessible with the engine out, giving you extra peace of mind.
Read our full guide to [how we decide between rebuild, replacement, or a used engine](/guides).

sections.heading: Our Engine Replacement Process - Step by Step

steps.title: Vehicle Arrival & Assessment
steps.body: We position your Jaguar in our workshop and confirm the exact replacement engine specification against your VIN and engine code.

steps.title: Disconnection & Preparation
steps.body: All electrical connectors, coolant hoses, fuel lines, and exhaust components are carefully disconnected and labelled for reassembly.

steps.title: Engine Extraction
steps.body: Using an engine hoist (or subframe drop where required), we remove the old engine from the vehicle - a process tailored to each Jaguar model.

steps.title: Replacement Engine Preparation
steps.body: We mount the replacement engine on a stand, transfer any needed ancillaries (alternator, sensors, manifolds), and install upgraded parts (timing chains, water pumps) while access is easy.

steps.title: Installation & Reconnection
steps.body: The replacement engine is carefully lowered into the bay, all mounts are secured, and every electrical and fluid line is reconnected to factory specifications.

steps.title: Fluid Fill & System Bleeding
steps.body: Engine oil and coolant are filled, and the cooling system is bled using Jaguar-specific procedures to prevent airlocks.

steps.title: Electronic Programming & Testing
steps.body: We perform ECU coding and security synchronisation using JLR SDD/Pathfinder, and run electronic throttle adaptation. Full road testing follows.

steps.title: Handover & Warranty
steps.body: Your Jaguar is returned with a detailed summary of the work and a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty on the replacement.

items: Jaguar Engine Removal, Refit & Final Testing

items.q: How long does a Jaguar engine replacement take?
items.a: Once the replacement engine is on site and work begins, we typically complete the job within 1-3 working days. Sourcing the correct engine can add a few days, so we advise allowing 1-2 weeks from initial enquiry to handover.

items.q: Do you supply the replacement engine, or do I need to find one?
items.a: We supply and fit the replacement engine as a complete service. We source the correct unit for your Jaguar - whether a rebuilt, reconditioned, or low-mileage used engine - to match your exact specification.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on a replacement engine?
items.a: All our engine replacements come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour for the replacement engine itself. Full terms are provided at handover.

items.q: Can I upgrade my engine to a more powerful variant?
items.a: In many cases, yes. We can advise on compatible performance upgrades - for example, fitting a supercharged V8 in place of a naturally aspirated one - subject to ECU coding and compatibility. Contact us to discuss your options.

items.q: Do you offer collection and delivery?
items.a: Yes, our nationwide recovery service can collect your Jaguar from anywhere in the UK and return it to you once the work is complete. This is available as part of our engine replacement service.
